description: Ultra fast grep: search for PATTERN in files, archives and compressed files.

option.name: --after-context
tip: Output NUM lines of trailing context after matching lines.

option.name: --all
tip: Search all files except hidden, cancelling earlier file and directory restrictions.
Also cancels --ignore-binary and --ignore-files.

option.name: --and
tip: Specify an additional PATTERN that must match.
Additional -e PATTERN values are alternatives inside the AND.

option.name: --andnot
tip: Combine --and with --not.

option.name: --basic-regexp
tip: Interpret patterns as basic regular expressions (BREs).

option.name: --before-context
tip: Output NUM lines of leading context before matching lines.

option.name: --binary
tip: Disable Unicode matching for ASCII and binary matching.

option.name: --binary-files
tip: Controls searching and reporting pattern matches in binary files.
Possible values: binary, without-match, text, hex, with-hex.

option.name: --bool
tip: Specify Boolean query patterns with AND, OR and NOT operators.
Spacing means AND, | means OR and - means NOT.

option.name: --break
tip: Add a line break between results from different files.

option.name: --byte-offset
tip: Display the byte offset of each pattern match in front of the matched line.

option.name: --colour
tip: Mark up matching text with colors.
Possible values: always, auto, never.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --colours=
tip: Use COLORS to mark up text.
A colon-separated list of parameters such as sl=, mt=, fn= and ln=.

option.name: --column-number
tip: Display the column number of each pattern match in front of the matched line.

option.name: --config
tip: Use configuration FILE.
The default FILE is `.ugrep`.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --context
tip: Output NUM lines of leading and trailing context around matching lines.

option.name: --context-separator=
tip: Use SEP as the field separator for context lines.

option.name: --count
tip: Write only a count of selected lines to standard output.

option.name: --cpp
tip: Output file matches in C++.

option.name: --csv
tip: Output file matches in CSV.

option.name: --decompress
tip: Search compressed files and archives.

option.name: --delay=
tip: Set the default -Q key response delay in increments of 100ms.
The default is 3.

option.name: --depth
tip: Restrict recursive searches to MIN to MAX directory levels deep.
Short forms such as -3-5 and -3,5 select a range.
Enables -r if neither -R nor -r is specified.

option.name: --dereference-files
tip: When -r is specified, follow symbolic links to files but not directories.

option.name: --dereference-recursive
tip: Read files recursively, following all symbolic links.

option.name: --devices
tip: How to handle devices, FIFOs and sockets.
Possible values: read, skip.

option.name: --directories
tip: How to handle directories.
Possible values: dereference-recurse, read, recurse, skip.

option.name: --dotall
tip: Make `.` in regular expressions match anything, including newline.

option.name: --empty
tip: Let empty-matching patterns match all lines.
Normally empty matches are not output unless the pattern starts with ^ or ends with $.
Enabled by default in grep compatibility mode.

option.name: --encoding=
tip: The encoding format of the input.
The default is binary or UTF-8.

Possible values: ASCII, CP1250, CP1251, CP1252, CP1253, CP1254, CP1255, CP1256, CP1257, CP1258, CP437, CP850, CP858, EBCDIC, ISO-8859-1, ISO-8859-10, ISO-8859-11, ISO-8859-13, ISO-8859-14, ISO-8859-15, ISO-8859-16, ISO-8859-2, ISO-8859-3, ISO-8859-4, ISO-8859-5, ISO-8859-6, ISO-8859-7, ISO-8859-8, ISO-8859-9, KOI8-R, KOI8-RU, KOI8-U, LATIN1, MAC, MACROMAN, UTF-16, UTF-16BE, UTF-16LE, UTF-32, UTF-32BE, UTF-32LE, UTF-8, binary, null-data.

option.name: --exclude
tip: Exclude files whose name matches GLOB.
Same as -g ^GLOB.

option.name: --exclude-dir
tip: Exclude directories whose name matches GLOB from recursive searches.

option.name: --exclude-from
tip: Read globs from FILE and skip matching files and directories.

option.name: --exclude-fs
tip: Exclude the file systems given by MOUNTS from recursive searches.
MOUNTS is a comma-separated list of mount points or pathnames.

option.name: --extended-regexp
tip: Interpret patterns as extended regular expressions (the default).

option.name: --file
tip: Read newline-separated patterns from FILE.
If FILE does not exist, the GREP_PATH environment variable is used to locate it.

option.name: --file-extension=
tip: Search only files whose extensions match the comma-separated EXTENSIONS.

option.name: --file-magic=
tip: Search only files whose magic bytes match the MAGIC regex.

option.name: --file-type=
tip: Search only files of the comma-separated TYPES.
Capitalized types also match files by magic bytes.
Precede a type with ! or ^ to exclude it.

Possible values: actionscript, ada, adoc, asm, asp, aspx, autoconf, automake, awk, Awk, basic, batch, bison, c, c++, clojure, cpp, csharp, css, csv, dart, Dart, delphi, elisp, elixir, erlang, fortran, gif, Gif, go, groovy, gsp, haskell, html, jade, java, jpeg, Jpeg, js, json, jsp, julia, kotlin, less, lex, lisp, lua, m4, make, markdown, matlab, node, Node, objc, objc++, ocaml, parrot, pascal, pdf, Pdf, perl, Perl, php, Php, png, Png, prolog, python, Python, r, rpm, Rpm, rst, rtf, Rtf, ruby, Ruby, rust, scala, scheme, seed7, shell, Shell, smalltalk, sql, svg, swift, tcl, tex, text, tiff, Tiff, tt, typescript, verilog, vhdl, vim, xml, Xml, yacc, yaml, zig, list.

option.name: --files
tip: Boolean file matching mode for --bool, the opposite of --lines.
The -%% short form enables --bool and --files together.

option.name: --files-with-matches
tip: Write only the names of files that contain selected lines.

option.name: --files-without-match
tip: Write only the names of files that contain no selected lines.

option.name: --filter-magic-label=
tip: Associate LABEL with files whose magic bytes match the MAGIC regex.
Only files without a filename extension are labeled unless +LABEL is given.

option.name: --filter=
tip: Filter files through COMMANDS before searching.
COMMANDS is a comma-separated list of ext:command entries.

option.name: --fixed-strings
tip: Interpret pattern as a set of fixed strings, separated by newlines.

option.name: --format=
tip: Output matches in FORMAT format.
See `ugrep --help format` for the field list.

option.name: --free-space
tip: Ignore spacing (blanks and tabs) in regular expressions.

option.name: --from
tip: Read additional pathnames of files to search from FILE.

option.name: --fuzzy
tip: Report approximate pattern matches within MAX errors.
The default -Z1 allows one insertion, deletion or substitution.
best, +, - and ~ refine the match policy.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --glob-ignore-case
tip: Perform case-insensitive glob matching in general.

option.name: --glob=
tip: Search only files whose name matches the comma-separated GLOBS.
Precede a glob with ! or ^ to exclude it.

option.name: --group-separator
tip: Use SEP as a group separator for context options -A, -B and -C.
The default is a double hyphen.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --heading
tip: Group matches per file with a heading and a line break.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help for WHAT when specified.
WHAT may be a topic such as regex, globs, fuzzy or format, or an option name.

option.name: --hex
tip: Output matches and matching lines in hexadecimal.

option.name: --hexdump
tip: Output matches in 1 to 8 columns of 8 hexadecimal octets.
The default is 2 columns or 16 octets per line.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --hidden
tip: Search hidden files and directories.
Hidden files are skipped by default.
Enabled by default in grep compatibility mode.

option.name: --hyperlink
tip: Enable hyperlinks for file names when colors are enabled.
Same as --colors=hl.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --iglob
tip: Like --glob but performs case-insensitive name matching.

option.name: --ignore-binary
tip: Ignore matches in binary files.
Equivalent to --binary-files=without-match.

option.name: --ignore-case
tip: Perform case-insensitive matching.

option.name: --ignore-files
tip: Ignore files and directories matching the globs in each FILE.
The default FILE is `.gitignore`.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --include
tip: Search only files whose name matches GLOB.
Same as -g GLOB.

option.name: --include-dir
tip: Include only directories whose name matches GLOB in recursive searches.

option.name: --include-from
tip: Read globs from FILE and search only matching files and directories.

option.name: --include-fs
tip: Include only the file systems given by MOUNTS in recursive searches.
MOUNTS is a comma-separated list of mount points or pathnames.

option.name: --index
tip: Perform fast index-based recursive search.
Assumes that files are indexed with ugrep-indexer.
Enables -r or --recursive.

option.name: --initial-tab
tip: Add a tab space between the metadata and the matched line.

option.name: --invert-match
tip: Select lines that do not match any pattern.

option.name: --jobs=
tip: Set the number of threads spawned to search files.

option.name: --json
tip: Output file matches in JSON.

option.name: --label
tip: Display LABEL where a file name would be printed when reading standard input.
The default is (standard input).

option.name: --line-buffered
tip: Force output to be line buffered instead of block buffered.

option.name: --line-number
tip: Precede each output line with its line number.

option.name: --line-regexp
tip: Select only matches that exactly match the whole line.

option.name: --lines
tip: Boolean line matching mode for --bool, the default mode.

option.name: --match
tip: Match all lines, the same as specifying an empty pattern.

option.name: --max-count=
tip: Stop reading input after MAX matches.
Same as -m,MAX.

option.name: --max-files=
tip: Restrict the number of matched files to NUM.

option.name: --max-line=
tip: Stop reading input after line MAX.

option.name: --max-size=
tip: Only search files whose size does not exceed MAX bytes.
Suffix MAX with kb, mb, gb or tb.

option.name: --min-count=
tip: Require MIN matches.
Same as -mMIN.

option.name: --min-line=
tip: Start searching at line MIN.

option.name: --min-size=
tip: Only search files whose size equals or exceeds MIN bytes.
Suffix MIN with kb, mb, gb or tb.

option.name: --mmap
tip: Use memory maps to search files.
When MAX is specified, use up to MAX mmap memory per thread.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --neg-regexp=
tip: Specify a negative PATTERN that rejects specific -e PATTERN matches.

option.name: --no-binary
tip: Disable --binary.

option.name: --no-bool
tip: Disable --bool.

option.name: --no-break
tip: Disable --break.

option.name: --no-byte-offset
tip: Disable --byte-offset.

option.name: --no-colour
tip: Disable --colour.

option.name: --no-config
tip: Do not automatically load the default .ugrep configuration file.

option.name: --no-confirm
tip: Do not confirm actions in the -Q query TUI.

option.name: --no-count
tip: Disable --count.

option.name: --no-decompress
tip: Disable --decompress.

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: Do not follow symbolic links when -R or -r is specified.

option.name: --no-dereference-files
tip: Disable --dereference-files.

option.name: --no-dotall
tip: Disable --dotall.

option.name: --no-empty
tip: Disable --empty.

option.name: --no-encoding
tip: Disable --encoding.

option.name: --no-filename
tip: Never print filenames with output lines.

option.name: --no-files-with-matches
tip: Disable --files-with-matches.

option.name: --no-filter
tip: Disable --filter.

option.name: --no-glob-ignore-case
tip: Disable --glob-ignore-case.

option.name: --no-group-separator
tip: Remove the group separator line from context output.

option.name: --no-heading
tip: Disable --heading.

option.name: --no-hidden
tip: Disable --hidden.

option.name: --no-hyperlink
tip: Disable --hyperlink.

option.name: --no-ignore-binary
tip: Disable --ignore-binary.

option.name: --no-ignore-case
tip: Disable --ignore-case.

option.name: --no-ignore-files
tip: Do not ignore files, cancelling --ignore-files.

option.name: --no-index
tip: Disable --index.

option.name: --no-initial-tab
tip: Disable --initial-tab.

option.name: --no-invert-match
tip: Disable --invert-match.

option.name: --no-line-number
tip: Disable --line-number.

option.name: --no-messages
tip: Ignore nonexistent and unreadable files and suppress their messages.

option.name: --no-mmap
tip: Disable --mmap.

option.name: --no-only-line-number
tip: Disable --only-line-number.

option.name: --no-only-matching
tip: Disable --only-matching.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Disable --pager.

option.name: --no-passthru
tip: Disable --passthru.

option.name: --no-pretty
tip: Disable --pretty.

option.name: --no-smart-case
tip: Disable --smart-case.

option.name: --no-sort
tip: Disable --sort.

option.name: --no-split
tip: Disable --split.

option.name: --no-stats
tip: Disable --stats.

option.name: --no-tree
tip: Disable --tree.

option.name: --no-ungroup
tip: Disable --ungroup.

option.name: --no-view
tip: Disable --view.

option.name: --not
tip: Specify that PATTERN should not match.

option.name: --null
tip: Output a zero byte after the file name.

option.name: --null-data
tip: Treat input and output lines as terminated by a zero byte instead of a newline.

option.name: --only-line-number
tip: Output only the line number of a matching line.

option.name: --only-matching
tip: Output only the matching part of a line.

option.name: --pager
tip: Page output through COMMAND when output is sent to the terminal.
Defaults to $PAGER or less.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --passthru
tip: Output every line, with non-matching lines shown as context.

option.name: --perl-regexp
tip: Interpret PATTERN as a Perl regular expression using PCRE2.

option.name: --pretty
tip: Enable colors, headings, line numbers, sorting, tree output and initial tabs when output is a terminal.
Only options not explicitly disabled are enabled.
The value must be attached with =.
Possible values: always, auto, never.

option.name: --query
tip: Start an interactive search TUI.
An optional DELAY in 100ms increments controls the response time.
No whitespace may be given between -Q and its argument.

option.name: --range=
tip: Start searching at line MIN and stop reading input after line MAX.

option.name: --recursive
tip: Read files recursively, following symbolic links only on the command line.

option.name: --regexp
tip: Specify a PATTERN to search the input.
May be repeated to specify multiple patterns.

option.name: --replace=
tip: Replace matching patterns in the output using FORMAT.
With -P, FORMAT may include capture groups %1 to %9.

option.name: --save-config
tip: Save configuration FILE containing the specified options.
The default FILE is `.ugrep`.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --separator
tip: Use SEP as the field separator between metadata and the matched line.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --silent
tip: Quiet mode: suppress all output and stop at the first match.

option.name: --smart-case
tip: Perform case-insensitive matching unless the pattern contains an uppercase letter.

option.name: --sort
tip: Sort matching files by KEY in recursive searches.
The value must be attached with =.
Possible values: best, changed, created, list, name, rbest, rchanged, rcreated, rlist, rname, rsize, rused, size, used.

option.name: --split
tip: Split the -Q query TUI screen on startup.

option.name: --stats
tip: Output statistics on the number of files and directories searched.

option.name: --tabs
tip: Set the tab size used to expand tabs for --column-number.
The default is 8.
The value must be attached with =.
Possible values: 1, 2, 4, 8.

option.name: --tag
tip: Mark up matches with TAG instead of colors.
END marks the end of a match when specified.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --text
tip: Process a binary file as if it were text.
May output binary garbage to the terminal.

option.name: --tree
tip: Output directories with matching files in a tree-like format.

option.name: --ungroup
tip: Do not group multiple pattern matches on the same line.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version with linked libraries and exit.

option.name: --view
tip: Use COMMAND to view or edit a file in the -Q query TUI.
+COMMAND waits for a key press after COMMAND terminates.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --width
tip: Truncate output to NUM visible characters per line.
The terminal width is used when NUM is not specified.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --with-filename
tip: Always print the filename with output lines.

option.name: --with-hex
tip: Output binary matches in hexadecimal, leaving text matches alone.

option.name: --word-regexp
tip: Search for PATTERN as a word.

option.name: --xml
tip: Output file matches in XML.

option.name: --zmax=
tip: Search up to NUM levels deep inside compressed files and archives.
NUM may range from 1 to 99.
Enable Boolean query patterns and Boolean file matching, the same as --bool --files.

option.name: -m
tip: Require MIN matches and stop reading input after MAX matches.
MIN and MAX may be given as one value, MIN,MAX.
